issues: Actionable: the public addendum paragraph ('Tolerances admit LP-solver numeric noise: repeated and independent GLPK-cobra runs of this exact analysis differ from the reference by at most ~5e-13 (relative)...') makes a quantitative calibration claim that is not substantiated by the supplied controller records: the repeatability replays record only byte-hash and row-multiset differences with 'scientific_equivalence_established: false', and the recomputed/alternative controls report only pass/fail under the 1e-8 tolerance, not measured magnitudes. Per the governing convention (public rules explain what is accepted; run-specific calibration measurements and validation history stay in the private rationale), remove the ~5e-13 figure from the public text (or replace it with a qualitative statement, e.g. that both independent executions and reference replays pass well within the stated tolerance, which the records do establish) and keep the measured-noise figure in the private rationale. The tolerance itself (1e-8 + 1e-9|ref| with the ~0.077 smallest distinct phenotype seven orders above the floor) remains defensible and must not be changed.
rationale: All six published checks map one-to-one to the executed grader code with fully defined comparison conventions, all 14 freshly executed controls on candidate 80a50c94… meet their expected outcomes (reference/recomputed/alternative pass; empty, misplaced outputs/-layer, and per-file-missing controls correctly fail; five wrong_solution probes fail on exactly their intended checks via valid CSV edits; the valid-representation control passes all checks), and the repair is a verified annotation/rule-alignment with no scientific change: the b0979 correction (+5.0e-7, ~46x out of tolerance) matches the frozen script's unchanged edit, the controller's before/after hashes, and the recorded grader failure; the literal-NaN tightening aligns code and prose without removing an obligation and breaks no executed control. Source coverage is complete (137/95/4560 rows, 95+4465 diagonal-inclusive set correctly reconciled; exclusions are source-backed demos/diagnostics). Two verified points require no change and are recorded here rather than as open issues: (a) the frozen probe script's inline '+5e-9, inside the stated tolerance' comment contradicts the corrected annotation, but the executed effect is independently established by the controller's hash records and grader report, so the frozen mutation must not be changed for cosmetic cleanup; (b) diagonal_check() reads the reference single-reaction file without using its rows — harmless. The single remaining actionable defect is the public ~5e-13 max-relative-noise calibration claim, which is not substantiated by the supplied executed-record evidence and belongs in the private rationale per the governing convention; correcting that wording does not alter any acceptance criterion, tolerance, check ID or scientific requirement. After revision, the affected controls and this review must be repeated on the new candidate.

source_coverage.rationale: The original converted source's terminal scientific results are the three named, stored deletion tables of the textbook E. coli model: deletion_results = single_gene_deletion(cobra_model) (137 genes), single = single_reaction_deletion(cobra_model) (95 reactions), and double = double_reaction_deletion(cobra_model) (4560 targets = the 95-reaction diagonal plus 4465 unordered pairs, confirmed by the recorded 4560-row artifact containing bare-identifier diagonal keys and corroborated by the source's double.knockout[{atpm}] singleton lookup). All three are exported and requested as public outputs; no eligible terminal scientific result is omitted. The preparation plan's exclusions are source-backed and defensible: the subset deletion demonstrations (genes[:20], reactions[:20], reactions[2:7], the rounded 5-gene textbook double-gene display) and the PFK/pfkA/pfkB knockout prints are unnamed inline demonstrations/diagnostics whose single-target content is subsumed by the exported full tables; the iJO1366 25-gene runs are a multiprocessing timing benchmark on a different model, outside this task's textbook-model scientific question; the knockout-indexer selections read from the already-exported tables. The earlier '96 reactions / 4465 pairs' arithmetic discrepancy in the preparation proposal was resolved to 95 + 4465 = 4560, matching the recorded reference endpoint rather than shrinking the table. Input lineage is faithful: the model is staged byte-for-byte from the pinned cobra package resource that load_model('textbook') resolves to, with the empty original-input manifest enforced loudly.
remaining_validation: Packaging-time oracle/isolation checks and blind-solver behavior remain outstanding; this source audit does not establish them.

The diagnostic/demo classification of the textbook-model inline demonstrations (rounded 5-gene double-gene display, PFK/pfkA/pfkB knockout prints) is accepted on the source-backed grounds recorded in the preparation plan (never bound to named stored results; pedagogical narrative). If a later review standard reclassified inline-printed gene-pair phenotypes as independent endpoints, that would be a new question, not an omission in this task as constructed.
